SELECT r.EditorID,
       json_extract(r.Data,'$.Level.Level') AS Lvl,
       json_extract(r.Data,'$.Race') AS Race,
       json_extract(r.Data,'$.UseTemplateActors') AS UTA,
       json_extract(r.Data,'$.TemplateActors.FactionsTemplate') AS FactTpl,
       json_extract(r.Data,'$.DefaultTemplate') AS DefTpl,
       (SELECT group_concat(json_extract(f.value,'$.Faction'),' ; ') FROM json_each(json_extract(r.Data,'$.Factions')) f) AS OwnFactions,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM Refs x WHERE x.ToFormKey = r.FormKey) AS InRefs
FROM Records r
WHERE r.Signature = 'Npc' AND r.IsOverride = 0
ORDER BY r.EditorID;

SELECT r.EditorID AS List,
       json_extract(e.value,'$.Level') AS Lvl,
       json_extract(e.value,'$.Reference') AS Entry
FROM Records r, json_each(json_extract(r.Data,'$.Entries')) e
WHERE r.Signature = 'LeveledNpc'
ORDER BY r.EditorID, CAST(json_extract(e.value,'$.Level') AS INTEGER);

-- For every NPC in the plugin: follow "Use Factions" inheritance (template or leveled list) until reaching
-- the record that owns its factions. Reports each NPC's owner(s) and the leveled-list entry ("tier") it passed through.
WITH npc AS (
  SELECT FormKey AS fk, EditorID AS ed,
         json_extract(Data,'$.Race') AS race,
         json_extract(Data,'$.Level.Level') AS lvl,
         CASE WHEN json_extract(Data,'$.UseTemplateActors') GLOB '[0-9]*'
              THEN (CAST(json_extract(Data,'$.UseTemplateActors') AS INTEGER) & 4) != 0
              ELSE instr(coalesce(json_extract(Data,'$.UseTemplateActors'),''),'Factions') > 0 END AS inh,
         coalesce(json_extract(Data,'$.TemplateActors.FactionsTemplate'), json_extract(Data,'$.DefaultTemplate')) AS par,
         (SELECT group_concat(json_extract(f.value,'$.Faction'),' ; ') FROM json_each(json_extract(Data,'$.Factions')) f) AS facs
  FROM Records WHERE Signature = 'Npc'
),
lvln AS (
  SELECT r.FormKey AS fk, r.EditorID AS ed, json_extract(e.value,'$.Reference') AS ent, json_extract(e.value,'$.Level') AS lv
  FROM Records r, json_each(json_extract(r.Data,'$.Entries')) e WHERE r.Signature = 'LeveledNpc'
),
walk(start, cur, depth, tier, viaList) AS (
  SELECT fk, fk, 0, NULL, NULL FROM npc
  UNION
  SELECT w.start, n.par, w.depth + 1, w.tier, w.viaList
    FROM walk w JOIN npc n ON n.fk = w.cur WHERE n.inh AND n.par IS NOT NULL AND w.depth < 20
  UNION
  SELECT w.start, l.ent, w.depth + 1, coalesce(w.tier, l.ent), coalesce(w.viaList, l.ed)
    FROM walk w JOIN lvln l ON l.fk = w.cur WHERE w.depth < 20
)
SELECT s.ed AS NPC, s.race AS Race,
       group_concat(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.fk IS NULL AND l2.fk IS NULL THEN w.cur ELSE o.ed END) AS FactionOwner,
       group_concat(DISTINCT o.facs) AS OwnerFactions,
       group_concat(DISTINCT w.viaList) AS ViaList
FROM npc s
JOIN walk w ON w.start = s.fk
LEFT JOIN npc o ON o.fk = w.cur AND NOT o.inh
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fk FROM lvln) l2 ON l2.fk = w.cur
LEFT JOIN npc mid ON mid.fk = w.cur AND mid.inh
WHERE (o.fk IS NOT NULL) OR (mid.fk IS NULL AND l2.fk IS NULL)
GROUP BY s.fk
ORDER BY FactionOwner, s.ed;

-- For every NPC in the plugin: follow "Use Factions" inheritance (template or leveled list) until reaching
-- the record that owns its factions. Reports each NPC's owner(s) and the leveled-list entry ("tier") it passed through.
WITH npc AS (
  SELECT FormKey AS fk, EditorID AS ed,
         json_extract(Data,'$.Race') AS race,
         json_extract(Data,'$.Level.Level') AS lvl,
         CASE WHEN json_extract(Data,'$.UseTemplateActors') GLOB '[0-9]*'
              THEN (CAST(json_extract(Data,'$.UseTemplateActors') AS INTEGER) & 4) != 0
              ELSE instr(coalesce(json_extract(Data,'$.UseTemplateActors'),''),'Factions') > 0 END AS inh,
         coalesce(json_extract(Data,'$.TemplateActors.FactionsTemplate'), json_extract(Data,'$.DefaultTemplate')) AS par,
         (SELECT group_concat(json_extract(f.value,'$.Faction'),' ; ') FROM json_each(json_extract(Data,'$.Factions')) f) AS facs
  FROM Records WHERE Signature = 'Npc'
),
lvln AS (
  SELECT r.FormKey AS fk, r.EditorID AS ed, json_extract(e.value,'$.Reference') AS ent, json_extract(e.value,'$.Level') AS lv
  FROM Records r, json_each(json_extract(r.Data,'$.Entries')) e WHERE r.Signature = 'LeveledNpc'
),
walk(start, cur, depth, tier, viaList) AS (
  SELECT fk, fk, 0, NULL, NULL FROM npc
  UNION
  SELECT w.start, n.par, w.depth + 1, w.tier, w.viaList
    FROM walk w JOIN npc n ON n.fk = w.cur WHERE n.inh AND n.par IS NOT NULL AND w.depth < 20
  UNION
  SELECT w.start, l.ent, w.depth + 1, coalesce(w.tier, l.ent), coalesce(w.viaList, l.ed)
    FROM walk w JOIN lvln l ON l.fk = w.cur WHERE w.depth < 20
)
SELECT s.ed AS NPC, s.race AS Race,
       group_concat(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.fk IS NULL AND l2.fk IS NULL THEN w.cur ELSE o.ed END) AS FactionOwner,
       group_concat(DISTINCT o.facs) AS OwnerFactions,
       group_concat(DISTINCT w.viaList) AS ViaList
FROM npc s
JOIN walk w ON w.start = s.fk
LEFT JOIN npc o ON o.fk = w.cur AND NOT o.inh
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fk FROM lvln) l2 ON l2.fk = w.cur
LEFT JOIN npc mid ON mid.fk = w.cur AND mid.inh
WHERE (o.fk IS NOT NULL) OR (mid.fk IS NULL AND l2.fk IS NULL)
GROUP BY s.fk
ORDER BY FactionOwner, s.ed;

WITH w AS (
  SELECT r.FormKey, r.EditorID, json_extract(r.Data,'$.Archetype') AS Arch,
    CAST(json_extract(r.Data,'$.AttackDamage') AS REAL)
      + coalesce((SELECT sum(CAST(json_extract(d.value,'$.Value') AS REAL)) FROM json_each(r.Data,'$.DamageTypes') d WHERE CAST(json_extract(d.value,'$.Value') AS REAL) > 1),0) AS Dmg,
    max(1, CAST(json_extract(r.Data,'$.ProjectilesCount') AS REAL)) AS Proj,
    CAST(json_extract(r.Data,'$.AmmoCapacity') AS REAL) AS Cap,
    CAST(json_extract(r.Data,'$.ShotsPerSecond') AS REAL) AS Sps,
    CAST(json_extract(r.Data,'$.AttackSeconds') AS REAL) AS AtkSec,
    CAST(json_extract(r.Data,'$.ReloadSpeed') AS REAL) AS Rld,
    (SELECT k.value FROM json_each(r.Data,'$.Keywords') k WHERE k.value LIKE '%:DarkStar_Manufacturing.esm' AND k.value IN (SELECT FormKey FROM Records WHERE Signature='Keyword' AND EditorID LIKE 'ma\_%\_Quality\_MkII' ESCAPE '\')) AS QKw
  FROM Records r WHERE r.Signature='Weapon' AND r.EditorID LIKE 'DSM\_Mk2\_%' ESCAPE '\'
),
q AS (
  SELECT t.value AS Kw,
    CAST(substr(o.EditorID, length(o.EditorID)) AS INTEGER) AS Tier,
    (SELECT max(CAST(json_extract(p.value,'$.Value') AS REAL)) FROM json_each(o.Data,'$.Properties') p
       WHERE json_extract(p.value,'$.Property') IN ('AttackDamage','DamageTypeValue')) AS Mult,
    (SELECT json_extract(p.value,'$.FunctionType') FROM json_each(o.Data,'$.Properties') p
       WHERE json_extract(p.value,'$.Property') IN ('AttackDamage','DamageTypeValue') LIMIT 1) AS Fn
  FROM Records o, json_each(o.Data,'$.TargetOmodKeywords') t
  WHERE o.Signature='ObjectModification' OR o.Signature='WeaponModification'
),
calc AS (
  SELECT w.*,
    CASE WHEN w.Sps > 0 THEN 1.0/w.Sps WHEN w.AtkSec > 0 THEN w.AtkSec ELSE 0.1 END AS AS2,
    (SELECT Mult FROM q WHERE q.Kw = w.QKw AND q.Tier = 6) AS Q6,
    (SELECT Mult FROM q WHERE q.Kw = w.QKw AND q.Tier = 8) AS Q8,
    (SELECT Fn FROM q WHERE q.Kw = w.QKw AND q.Tier = 6) AS Fn
  FROM w
)
SELECT EditorID, Arch, round(Dmg*Proj,1) AS ShotDmg, Cap, round(1.0/AS2,2) AS ShotsPerSec,
  round(CASE WHEN Arch='Melee' THEN Dmg/AS2 ELSE Dmg*Proj*max(Cap,1)/(max(Cap,1)*AS2 + 1.0/CASE WHEN Rld>0 THEN Rld ELSE 1 END) END,1) AS BaseDPS,
  Fn, round(Q6,3) AS Q6, round(Q8,3) AS Q8,
  round(CASE WHEN Arch='Melee' THEN Dmg/AS2 ELSE Dmg*Proj*max(Cap,1)/(max(Cap,1)*AS2 + 1.0/CASE WHEN Rld>0 THEN Rld ELSE 1 END) END * (1+Q6),0) AS Q6DPS,
  round(CASE WHEN Arch='Melee' THEN Dmg/AS2 ELSE Dmg*Proj*max(Cap,1)/(max(Cap,1)*AS2 + 1.0/CASE WHEN Rld>0 THEN Rld ELSE 1 END) END * (1+Q8),0) AS Q8DPS
FROM calc ORDER BY Arch, Q6DPS;

SELECT f.FormKey, f.EditorID, CASE WHEN x.FormKey IS NULL THEN 'FormsOnly' ELSE 'Full' END AS Cached, (SELECT group_concat(r.Path || '=' || r.ToFormKey || '=' || COALESCE(edid(r.ToFormKey),''), ' ; ') FROM Refs r WHERE r.FromFormKey = f.FormKey AND r.Path LIKE '%SpaceshipAIActor') AS Pilots FROM Forms f LEFT JOIN Records x ON x.FormKey = f.FormKey WHERE f.Signature = 'GenericBaseForm' AND f.IsOverride = 0 ORDER BY f.FormKey;

-- ## Vanilla OMODs that swap the projectile
SELECT edid(pp.value->>'Record') proj, COUNT(DISTINCT o.FormKey) omods, MIN(o.EditorID) example, MAX(o.EditorID) example2, edid(pr.Data->>'$.Explosion') expl, ex.Data->>'$.Damage' expl_dmg
FROM Records o CROSS JOIN json_each(o.Data,'$.Properties') pp
LEFT JOIN Records pr ON pr.FormKey = pp.value->>'Record' LEFT JOIN Records ex ON ex.FormKey = pr.Data->>'$.Explosion'
WHERE o.Signature='ObjectModification' AND pp.value->>'Property'='ProjectileOverride' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;
-- ## Vanilla weapons with an OverrideProjectile
SELECT EditorID, edid(Data->>'$.OverrideProjectile') oproj FROM Records WHERE Signature='Weapon' AND Data->>'$.OverrideProjectile' IS NOT NULL AND Data->>'$.OverrideProjectile' <> '000000:Null' LIMIT 40;

-- ## Grenade/mine: weapon -> override projectile -> explosion
SELECT w.EditorID, w.Data->>'$.AttackDamage' hit, edid(w.Data->>'$.AmmoType') ammo, edid(w.Data->>'$.OverrideProjectile') proj,
  p.Data->>'$.Flags' pflags, edid(p.Data->>'$.Explosion') expl, e.Data->>'$.Damage' expl_dmg, edid(w.Data->>'$.ObjectEffect') ench
FROM Records w LEFT JOIN Records p ON p.FormKey = w.Data->>'$.OverrideProjectile' LEFT JOIN Records e ON e.FormKey = p.Data->>'$.Explosion'
WHERE w.EditorID IN ('FragGrenade','FragMine','Rocketlauncher','Bridger','Companion_InflictorRifle','InflictorRifle');
-- ## Hornet's Nest projectile swap (any property mentioning a projectile)
SELECT o.EditorID, pp.value->>'Property' prop, edid(pp.value->>'Record') rec
FROM Records o CROSS JOIN json_each(o.Data,'$.Properties') pp
WHERE o.Signature='ObjectModification' AND o.EditorID LIKE '%Hornet%';

SELECT r.EditorID, r.Name,
  (SELECT group_concat(edid(k.value), ' ') FROM json_each(r.Data, '$.Keywords') k WHERE edid(k.value) LIKE '%Core%' OR edid(k.value) LIKE '%Laser%' OR edid(k.value) LIKE 'WeaponType%') AS kws,
  (SELECT group_concat(edid(a.value), ' ') FROM json_each(r.Data, '$.AttachParentSlots') a WHERE edid(a.value) LIKE '%Core%' OR edid(a.value) LIKE '%Laser%') AS slots
FROM Records r
WHERE r.Signature = 'Weapon' AND r.EditorID LIKE '%Mk3%' AND r.IsOverride = 0
  AND (r.EditorID LIKE '%PlasmaCutter%' OR r.EditorID LIKE '%Solstice%' OR r.EditorID LIKE '%Equinox%' OR r.EditorID LIKE '%ArcWelder%' OR r.EditorID LIKE '%Orion%' OR r.EditorID LIKE '%Eon%' OR r.EditorID LIKE '%Novalight%' OR r.EditorID LIKE '%Starshard%' OR r.EditorID LIKE '%Pacifier%' OR r.EditorID LIKE '%Breach%'
       OR r.Data LIKE '%008D19%' OR r.Data LIKE '%002BB1%')
ORDER BY r.EditorID;

SELECT r.EditorID, r.Name,
  edid(json_extract(r.Data, '$.OverrideProjectile')) AS proj,
  edid(json_extract(r.Data, '$.AmmoType')) AS ammo,
  (SELECT group_concat(replace(edid(k.value), 'WeaponType', ''), ' ') FROM json_each(r.Data, '$.Keywords') k WHERE edid(k.value) LIKE 'WeaponType%' OR edid(k.value) LIKE 'xR_Holster%') AS types,
  json_extract(r.Data, '$.AttackDamage') AS dmg
FROM Records r
WHERE r.Signature = 'Weapon' AND r.EditorID LIKE 'DarkStar_Mk3_%' AND r.IsOverride = 0
  AND (edid(json_extract(r.Data, '$.OverrideProjectile')) = 'ParticleProjectilePistol'
       OR r.EditorID LIKE '%Lawgiver%' OR r.EditorID LIKE '%Kodama%')
ORDER BY proj, r.EditorID;

-- Per armor type: how many have bounds, and the envelope (smallest min / largest max per axis) of the non-zero ones.
WITH b AS (
  SELECT json_extract(Data,'$.Archetype') AS kind,
         json_extract(Data,'$.ObjectBounds.First') AS f, json_extract(Data,'$.ObjectBounds.Second') AS s
  FROM Records WHERE Signature='Armor' AND IsOverride=0 AND json_extract(Data,'$.IsJunk') = 0
), p AS (
  SELECT kind, f, s,
    CAST(substr(f,1,instr(f,',')-1) AS REAL) AS x1,
    CAST(substr(f,instr(f,',')+1, instr(substr(f,instr(f,',')+1),',')-1) AS REAL) AS y1,
    CAST(substr(substr(f,instr(f,',')+1), instr(substr(f,instr(f,',')+1),',')+1) AS REAL) AS z1,
    CAST(substr(s,1,instr(s,',')-1) AS REAL) AS x2,
    CAST(substr(s,instr(s,',')+1, instr(substr(s,instr(s,',')+1),',')-1) AS REAL) AS y2,
    CAST(substr(substr(s,instr(s,',')+1), instr(substr(s,instr(s,',')+1),',')+1) AS REAL) AS z2
  FROM b WHERE NOT (f = '0, 0, 0' AND s = '0, 0, 0')
)
SELECT kind, COUNT(*) AS withBounds,
  printf('%.3f, %.3f, %.3f', MIN(x1), MIN(y1), MIN(z1)) AS envMin,
  printf('%.3f, %.3f, %.3f', MAX(x2), MAX(y2), MAX(z2)) AS envMax,
  printf('%.3f, %.3f, %.3f', AVG(x2-x1), AVG(y2-y1), AVG(z2-z1)) AS avgSize
FROM p GROUP BY kind;

-- Zero-bounds armor (vanilla + darkstar) and whether another record with the same world mesh has real bounds.
WITH a AS (
  SELECT FormKey, EditorID, json_extract(Data,'$.Archetype') AS kind,
         lower(json_extract(Data,'$.WorldModel[0].File.GivenPath')) AS mesh,
         (json_extract(Data,'$.ObjectBounds.First') = '0, 0, 0' AND json_extract(Data,'$.ObjectBounds.Second') = '0, 0, 0') AS zero
  FROM AllRecords WHERE Signature = 'Armor'
)
SELECT kind,
  SUM(zero) AS zeroBounds,
  SUM(zero AND mesh IS NULL) AS noMesh,
  SUM(zero AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM a n WHERE n.mesh = a.mesh AND n.zero = 0)) AS meshMatchHasBounds
FROM a GROUP BY kind;

-- Zero-bounds armor (vanilla + Shattered Space + darkstar) and whether another record with the same world mesh has real bounds.
WITH r AS (
  SELECT 'darkstar' AS src, Data FROM main.Records WHERE Signature = 'Armor' AND IsOverride = 0
  UNION ALL SELECT 'vanilla', Data FROM sf.Records WHERE Signature = 'Armor' AND IsOverride = 0
  UNION ALL SELECT 'vanilla', Data FROM sfbgs003.Records WHERE Signature = 'Armor' AND IsOverride = 0
), a AS (
  SELECT src, json_extract(Data,'$.Archetype') AS kind,
         lower(json_extract(Data,'$.WorldModel[0].File.GivenPath')) AS mesh,
         (json_extract(Data,'$.ObjectBounds.First') = '0, 0, 0' AND json_extract(Data,'$.ObjectBounds.Second') = '0, 0, 0') AS zero
  FROM r
), real AS (SELECT DISTINCT mesh FROM a WHERE zero = 0 AND mesh IS NOT NULL)
SELECT src, kind,
  SUM(zero) AS zeroBounds,
  SUM(zero AND mesh IS NULL) AS noMesh,
  SUM(zero AND mesh IN (SELECT mesh FROM real)) AS meshMatchHasBounds
FROM a GROUP BY src, kind ORDER BY src, kind;
